scene.ko: 팀원에게 발표 자료가 어디까지 됐는지, 남은 일과 막힌 부분을 묻는다.

lines.en: Hey, Chris. Do you have a minute? I wanted to check in on the sales presentation.
lines.ko: 크리스 씨, 잠깐 시간 돼요? 영업 발표 자료 어떻게 돼 가는지 확인하고 싶어서요.
alt: Hi, Chris. Got a minute? I wanted to see how the sales presentation is going.

lines.en: Sure. I've finished about half of the slides.
That's good. What's left to do?
alt: Good. What else needs to be done?
Nice. What do you still have to do?

lines.en: Mainly the sales numbers. I'm still waiting on the data from the finance team.
lines.ko: 주로 매출 숫자요. 재무팀 자료를 아직 기다리고 있어요.

lines.en: When did you ask them for it?
alt: How long ago did you ask them?

lines.en: Last Monday. I sent them a reminder yesterday, but I haven't heard back yet.
lines.ko: 지난주 월요일이요. 어제 다시 한번 요청했는데 아직 답이 없어요.

lines.en: Okay, I'll follow up with their manager today. Do you think you can still finish by Friday?
lines.ko: 알겠어요, 제가 오늘 그쪽 팀장님께 확인해 볼게요. 그래도 금요일까지 끝낼 수 있을 것 같아요?
alt: Got it. I'll talk to their manager today. Can you still be done by Friday?

lines.en: If I get the data by Wednesday, yes.
Great. Keep me posted, and let me know if anything changes.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 계속 상황 알려 주고, 바뀌는 게 있으면 말해 줘요.
alt: Perfect. Keep me updated, and tell me if anything changes.

expressions.en: I wanted to check in on ___.
expressions.note: check in on = 진행 상황을 확인하다
Keep me updated. 와 같은 뜻
